wrong_setting: The skyline has a Gothic-style church spire and generic European brick blocks, and the buses look like modern European city coaches, so nothing reads as Addis Ababa.
anatomy: Several figures in the middle distance are semi-transparent, ghostly smears with melted limbs.
notes: Repaint so the paint runs off all four edges with no ragged pale paper margin, swap the European spire and skyline for Addis-style buildings and typical Ethiopian long-distance buses, and make the translucent ghost figures solid.
